subject: Request: trial extension + conversion credit for Vertex AI POC
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@vertexai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension & credit to complete POC

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the engineering team is already running longer sequences and the model latency looks promising. We ran into a blocker on a third-party integration that will take ~2 weeks to resolve. That pushes our evaluation window past the trial end date.

Can Redwood extend the trial by 21 days and provide a one-time credit to cover incremental token consumption while we finish the integration? We're asking for $5,000 in credits so we can finish the last phase and validate end-to-end performance before we commit.

Attached is our latest usage snapshot (for visibility). Happy to hop on a quick call if you want more context.

Best,
Alyssa Nguyen
Program Manager, Vertex AI POCs
Vertex Labs

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & credit to complete POC

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and the usage file. That all makes sense. We're happy to support the final stretch.

Requesting the following so I can get approvals:
- Trial extension: 21 days (no change to current sandbox config)
- One-time credit: $5,000 applied to their trial account to cover additional token consumption
- Conversion condition: Vertex signs an annual commitment (min $120k ARR) or converts to a pay-as-you-go plan within 60 days of trial end; if they convert earlier, credits are forfeited.

Marissa — looping you in for approval. If finance/legal want to limit the credit or condition it differently, we can adjust.

Next step from our side is a short addendum (1 page) and a DocuSign wrapper to capture the conversion condition.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_terms_summary.txt (txt)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & credit to complete POC

Ben — thanks for the details. A few quick questions before I sign off:
1) Expected uplift / ARR: what’s the team's conservative ARR estimate if this converts? Please provide a 12-month ARR projection.
2) Risk/precedent: have we done $5k one-offs recently for similar accounts? If so, outcomes?
3) Legal: do we need a credit addendum or will a one-page DocuSign suffice?

Jonas — can you weigh in on acceptable credit thresholds? If we can't approve $5k here, propose an alternative so we have something to offer Vertex this week.

-Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & credit to complete POC

Quick answers:
1) Conservative 12-month ARR if converted: $150,000 (they are planning a small pilot in infra automation followed by a full rollout in two business units if the POC passes).
2) Recent precedent: we granted $4k in credits for Nimbus earlier this quarter; that converted to a $180k ARR pilot within 4 months.
3) Legal: one-page addendum + DocuSign should be fine — nothing changes in primary T&C, just a short credit clause and conversion condition.

Attaching a short deal summary and the usage export we discussed.

Thanks — Ben
[Attachment: deal_summary_vertex.docx (docx)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & credit to complete POC

Reviewed. Given the ARR projection ($150k) and the precedent you noted, we can approve a one-time credit. Proposed finance position:
- Approve up to $3,500 in trial credit without exec escalation
- If Sales wants to offer the full $5,000, that requires VP-level approval (Marissa or above) recorded in the deal notes
- Require a usage cap: credit applies to the next 45 days and stops at a $35k token-consumption equivalent to avoid runaway consumption

If Sales accepts $3,500 and the usage cap, I will mark the discount and update billing so it's automatically applied at trial account level.

-Jonas
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Jonas — good trade. Ben, go with the $3,500 credit + 45-day cap. Include a clause in the addendum that credits expire if they convert before the trial ends or if they don't sign the annual within 60 days. Olga, please prepare a one-page addendum (credit + conversion condition) and a DocuSign so Ben can send to Alyssa today.

Marissa
VP, Sales

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & credit to complete POC

Hi Alyssa — great news: we can extend your trial 21 days and apply a one-time $3,500 credit to cover incremental usage during the extension. Terms:
- Credit amount: $3,500 (one-time)
- Trial extension: 21 days starting when DocuSign is accepted
- Validity: credit covers up to 45 days of consumption and will be billed to the trial account (stop when credit consumed)
- Conversion condition: credit expires if you convert before trial end; if you sign an annual commitment for at least $120k ARR within 60 days after trial end, credits are honored and applied per the addendum.

I've attached the credit addendum and included a DocuSign link for signature. Please let me know if you want any changes — we can escalate if Vertex needs $5k, but this is the approved path to get you unblocked quickly.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/track/ABC123-vertex-credit
